title: Basename matching ignores the windows option
prompt: In our picomatch, the basename option (matchBase) is supposed to match a pattern without slashes against the last path segment, but it works out the last segment with the wrong path separator rules. With windows: true a path such as 'a\\b\\c.js' should match the pattern '*.js' with basename on, and with windows: false the backslash must not be treated as a separator. Please make it respect the windows option.
